title: Is the guidance on Recovery Codes and Account Lockout still current?

question.author: member_184
question.body: I found an older discussion about recovery codes and account lockout. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Security documentation says: If you lose both your authenticator and your codes, you must complete an identity verification with support, which takes up to 48 hours. Organization accounts additionally allow an administrator to reset a member's 2FA from the admin console. When you enroll in 2FA you receive 10 one-time recovery codes; store them somewhere safe, because they are the only way back in if you lose your authenticator. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
